The film belongs to the wave of historical films in the Turkish cinema . The film is about the beloved comics character of Ayhan Başoğlu , Malkoçoğlu . Sultan Cem or Cem Sultan ( December 22 , 1459 -- February 25 , 1495 ) ( [ ˈd͡ʒem sulˈtɑːn ] ; جم ) , also referred to as Jem Sultan , or Zizim by the French , was a pretender to the Ottoman throne in the 15th century . Cem was the third son of Sultan Mehmed II and younger half-brother of Sultan Bayezid II , and thus a half-uncle of Sultan Selim I of Ottoman Empire . After being defeated by Bayezid , Cem went on exile in Egypt and Europe , under the protection of the Mamluks , the Knights Hospitaller of St. John on the island of Rhodes , and ultimately the Pope .
